lib.title: Library
lib.noRootClick: No folder chosen — click to choose
sort.name: Name (A–Z)
empty.title: Build your manga shelf
empty.text:
Choose a main folder with one subfolder per volume (or Series › Volume).
Yomuchu lists everything with covers and remembers where you stopped.
empty.hint: Tip: you can also drag a folder into this window.
cont.title: Continue reading
hist.confirmText: The “Continue reading” list will be emptied. Your files will not be touched.
drop.title: Drop the folder here
drop.text: A folder with images opens in the reader · a folder with subfolders becomes the library
set.title: Settings
set.dirHint: Japanese manga reads right to left
set.pagesHint: Open book (two pages) or one page at a time
set.transpHint: The book floats over your desktop. On Linux it needs a compositor. Requires restart.
set.gpuHint: Use it if the reader window turns black on Linux. Requires restart.
keys.title: Reader shortcuts
donate.title: Support Yomuchu
donate.text: Yomuchu is free. If it makes your reading better, consider supporting its development!
err.noImages: No JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF images found in this folder.
help.title: Shortcuts
help.tip: Drag the book cover (edge) or the ⠿ handle to move the window. The bottom-right corner resizes it.
set.spreadsHint: Landscape images (wider than tall) fill the whole open book
lib.openLinkTip: Download a chapter from a web page address (Ctrl+L)
link.title: Open link
link.text: Paste the address of a chapter page. Yomuchu finds the pages, downloads them to a temporary folder and opens them in the reader.
link.legal: Only use this with content you have the right to read. Yomuchu does not bypass logins, paywalls, captchas or DRM.
link.e.badUrl: Invalid address. Use an http:// or https:// link.
link.e.noPages: No chapter pages were found at this link. Make sure it is the chapter page (with the images) and not the series list.
link.e.blocked: The site blocked access ({detail}). Yomuchu does not bypass logins, captchas or blocks.
link.e.tooBig: The chapter exceeds the size limit ({detail}).
link.e.busy: A download is already in progress.
links.confirmText: Chapters downloaded from links will be removed from this computer. You can download them again any time.
set.themeHint: Colors of the library and the reader.
set.backdropHint: Color behind the book. Changes live in the reader.
set.paperHint: Gives the pages a warm, yellowed tone, like old paper.
link.batch.text: Download several pages at once. Each link becomes one page of the chapter, in order. Yomuchu opens each link and takes the largest image on the page (the manga page, not the ads). If the link is already an image, it downloads it directly.
link.batch.listLabel: Links (separate with semicolons or one per line)
link.batch.insertTip: Inserts {n} at the cursor: the part of the address that changes from page to page
link.batch.hintSeq: Use {n} where the number or letter goes. Example: from 1 to 29 makes …/1, …/2 … …/29. For 01, 02…, type 01 in “From” or pick the digits. Letters go a to z, then aa, ab…
link.batch.e.noPattern: Put {n} in the address where the changing part goes.
link.batch.e.badRange: Check “From” and “To”: use whole numbers only.
link.batch.e.badAlpha: For letters, use only a–z (or only A–Z) in “From” and “To”, both in the same case.
link.batch.e.badStep: The step must be a whole number greater than 0.
link.batch.e.tooMany: That is {n} links, and the limit per batch is {max}.
link.batch.e.noPages: No image could be downloaded from this batch ({detail}).
link.batch.confirmText: This will visit {n} addresses on the site. Continue?
link.dup.title: Chapter already exists
link.dup.text: A chapter named “{name}” already exists. You may have already downloaded this manga. Download it again as a copy?
